title: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Sensex jumps over 1,500 points, Nifty nears 23,000; rupee extends gains
summary: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices Highlights: Indian equities rallied sharply despite a sell-off across Asian markets, as investors bought technology, private banking and defensive stocks. The rupee extended its winning streak to five sessions, while falling crude oil prices and bond yields supported sentiment.
